= PlantUML SVG regression fixture

`unit-type.svg` is native output from PlantUML 1.2026.3 (bundled with metanorma-plugin-plantuml 1.0.15) using the Smetana layout engine.
It represents the UnitsML XML Schema `UnitType` content model used by
https://github.com/unitsml/docs/pull/9[UnitsML documentation PR 9].
The embedded PlantUML source records its schema labels and diagram input.

The diagram links target anchors in the surrounding documentation page.
Standalone profile tests therefore check attribute validation separately from
those document-level references; the UnitsML documentation checks the targets.
The test preserves the SVG's measured text layout and link titles.
